attributes.name: Hrilga Shield-Maiden
attributes.powers:
If the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Basic trait, the difficulty to acquire Hrilga Shield-Maiden is increased by 3.

Discard this card to add 1d8 to your combat check, if the top card of the blessings discard pile has the Basic trait, add an additional 1d8.

Discard this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d6 to your combat checks.
